limitations: 20 section observations, 18 unique game URLs, five unique detail inspections. Bloxd.io and Boxity.io occur in both sections. Duplicate exposures retained without summing metrics.
Homepage US label is not a global ranking; DOM order is not an official rank. Bounded nonrandom sample.
Hot page monthly title conflicts with last-24-hours introduction. No unified time window inferred.
Missing metrics are null, not zero. Uninspected games do not inherit old metrics or descriptions. Ratings, votes, plays, users and directory sizes remain distinct.

20 cover representations downloaded locally and fully decoded as AVIF, size and SHA-256 verified. HTTP status and response Content-Type unavailable in supported browser API. All covers verification_incomplete, with null repository paths and successful download metadata. No cover files eligible for publication.
Five new Chinese descriptions cover six section records through same-run identity reuse; 14 records lack gameplay evidence and retain null descriptions.
Release-date conflicts preserved without expanding date precision. Ragdoll Archers has platform-specific body release dates and no Released header; header remains null.
Only cloud browser and GitHub connector used for source acquisition. No user computer, hidden APIs, active gameplay, votes or video downloads. Embedded games may auto-load.
